name: Project Assistant
description: Default AI assistant flow. The start packet carries { messages, meta } from the assistant HTTP handler. Edge conditions on `meta.intent` branch between a chat reply and a human-handoff request. Input is classified by guard-in; unsafe messages short-circuit to a rejection end. The assistant's reply is classified by guard-out before reaching the client. Customize LLM and guard settings via the FlowDSL Studio — no code changes needed.

config.systemPrompt: You are the Project Assistant for a Redelay-based application. Help developers understand the framework, debug issues, and find the right docs. Ground every answer in what the project ships today; say "I don't know" rather than guess.

config.template: I'm not able to help with that request. Your message was flagged by our safety classifier and has been forwarded to our team for review. If you believe this is a mistake, please rephrase your question or ask for a human via the 'Talk to a human' button.

I started to answer but pulled the response back — our safety classifier flagged my draft as potentially unsafe. Try rephrasing your question, or ask for a human via the 'Talk to a human' button and our team will follow up.

edges.description: Branch when the UI passes intent=handoff (e.g. user clicked 'Talk to a human'). Persists a HandoffRequest and emits assistant.handoff_requested for the notification flow.
Default path — user message goes to the safety classifier before the LLM.
Flagged but allowed — pass through for now; operators can tighten via admin settings.
Unsafe user input — route through the refusal transform so the client receives a configurable explanation instead of silence.
Carry the rendered refusal content into the rejection terminal — this is what the SSE pump streams to the client.
Safe or flagged model reply — deliver to the client.
Unsafe model output — suppress it and emit a configurable refusal instead.
Carry the rendered refusal content into the rejection terminal.

ChatRequest.description: Chat completion request with message history and optional tool definitions.

messages.description: Conversation history. Each item has role (system/user/assistant/tool) and content.

meta.description: Correlation + routing metadata — session_id, user_id, intent ('chat'|'handoff').

ChatResponse.description: LLM chat completion response with the assistant message and usage metadata.

HandoffRequest.description: Incoming handoff packet — the shape expected by redelay/assistant-handoff-request. `sessionId` and `email` are required; the assistant HTTP handler (POST /assistant/handoff) forwards the request body into the flow with `meta.intent=handoff`.

HandoffResponse.description: Result of a handoff request — the persisted record id, status at creation time, and a duplicate flag set when the service de-duplicated against an open request for the same session.

GuardRejection.description: Guard-driven rejection envelope. `decision.categories` carries the policy tags; UI should render a generic refusal message without leaking raw categories to end users.
